units.translation: Second aorist Eum. 368 ἁλομένα [having leapt]. For thus it is corrected in the apograph, whereas in M it is αλλωμένα [leaping], with the second λ erased. Similarly between ἁλόμενοι [having leapt], ἁλώμενοι [wandering] (sic) and αλλόμενοι [leaping] the manuscripts vary in Xen. Anab. 4, 2, 17 and elsewhere. The tragedians preferred the first aorist ἡλάμην [I leapt] to the second ἡλόμην [I leapt] (on which Veitch, Irregular Verbs p. 47 has spoken), certain forms of which beginning with short a they used for metrical reasons: hence Aeschylus said ἁλομένα [having leapt], not ἁλαμένα [having leapt], whose a seems to be long, as ἁλάμενος [having leapt] in Arist. Av. 1395. Similarly ἀράμενος [having lifted] is said with long a, but ἀρόμενος [having lifted] with short. Examples of the second aorist ἐνήλου [he leapt in] Pers. 515 (where ενήλλου [you were leaping in] in many apographs) and ἐξήλλου [you were leaping out] in Soph. O R. 1311 are due to scribal errors. Elmsley rightly wrote ἐνήλω [he leapt in] and ἐξήλω [he leapt out], and ἐξήλω [he leapt out] in Sophocles in two apographs, as at v. 263 and 1261 ενήλατο [he leapt in] is read, not ενήλετο or ενήλλετο, and ἀφήλατο [he leapt away] in Aeschylus Pers. 305.
other. It is used either adjectivally or substantivally.

[Pr. 156 ἄλλος [other] was introduced by a corrector in M for ανος, which means ἄνθρωπος [man], although this too is not correct, but ἀνδρῶν [of men] should be written, as I have shown in the annotation.]
[Ch. 995 μύραινά γ᾽ εἴτ᾽ ἔχιδν᾽ ἔφυ σήπειν θιγοῦσ᾽ ἂν ἄλλον [a moray or a viper, born to cause rot by touching another]. Ch. 1021 ἄλλος [other] is corrupt for ἀλλ᾽ ὡς [but as].]
With the article οἱ ἄλλοι [the others].
τὰ δ᾽ ἄλλα [the other things] with various verbs
τὰ δ᾽ ἄλλα πάντα [all the other things]
And τἄλλα [the other things] with the substantive added or omitted
[ ἄλλῃ [elsewhere] adverbially, alibi. Eum. 530 ἀλλ᾽ ἄλλα δ᾽ ἐφορεύει [but other things he oversees].]
Nevertheless, some other man ought to have obtained her.
Having destroyed the whole race, he desired to beget another new one.
In addition to what you have, you want to take other things.
Only before this have I seen another god.
Third in birth after ten other generations.
With others I will suffer my fate.
Say that another has obtained different gates.
A fourth, another, holding the neighboring gates.
Unless someone else wishes to bury him with me.
And others the great Nile sent.
Not hearing the words of others.
And others around the island of Ajax.
And indeed we long for another.
Another reception of the fire's escort.
Apart from others, I am alone in my mind.
This honor must come from others.
For another avenger of us will come.
Penalties for the deaths of others.
By no means – let us do other evils.
Him who is ruled by another's hand.
